name: Background Check

objectives.text: Obtain the bronze pocket watch on Customs
details: (Optional) Obtain the key to the fuel tanker truck

objectives.text: Hand over the found item

guide:
Head into the map Customs. The Machinery key is required to access the bronze pocket watch. So if you do not have one, head to room 205 located on the second floor of the three-story dorms building in the south.

To enter the room you'll need to jump on top of debris blocking the hallway and crouch to get inside the doorway of the room. The Machinery key can be found within the blue jackets beside the wardrobe. 

After obtaining the key, head north to the fuel tanker truck that is located at the construction site. The driver side door of the cabin can be unlocked with the Machinery key.

Inside, the Bronze pocket watch can be found laying on the floor in front of the seat. Be careful of the sniper Scav overlooking the truck from the roof of the nearby boiler building. 

After picking up the pocket watch, it will be placed in your quest items inventory. You must successfully extract with the pocket watch to hand it in. If you die before extraction, you will have to retrieve it again. Hand the pocket watch over to Prapor to complete the quest.

name: Delivery From the Past

objectives.text: Locate and obtain the valuable folder in Tarcone director's office on Customs
Stash the package in the break room on the 2nd floor near Gate 3 on Factory

items: Unlocks English herringbone Hideout floor style

guide:
To begin, you need to have the Tarcone Director's office key. If you do not have one, you can find it within drawers or from Scavs. It can also be bartered for with Therapist. Once you have obtained one, head to Customs. The first place you want to visit is the red Paradigm warehouse on the east side of the map. The office is found at the top of the metal stairs. After unlocking the door there will be two rooms. The second room is the one containing the documents. Be warned though, to enter this room the door must be breached, which will create a lot of noise. After entering the room, go to the desk and look just under the table top, on top of the drawers. Leaning may help you to see it. Extract from Customs. If you die at any point after picking up the documents and you still have them in your in raid quest inventory, they will be lost and must be reacquired. If you don't want to do the second part of the quest immediately, you can move the documents into your off-raid quest inventory in the character menu under the "tasks" tab.

It's time to head to Factory. You can complete this during the daytime or nighttime. With the documents in your in raid quest inventory, head towards the Gate 3 extraction. To the left of the extraction is a short metal staircase leading to a sheet metal room. This is where you must place the documents. To place them you, must hold down your use key (default F) for 10 seconds. For safety, you should lie down when placing them to be out of sight from the doorway and windows. If you die before the timer finishes, you need to retrieve the documents again. Hence, try to make sure nobody is around to disturb while you place the documents (i.e. either kill all other PMCs or wait until they have left the raid). After the placement is complete, you have to extract from the raid. The "Survived" extraction status is not required. You do not have to survive and extract on the same raid that you planted the documents, it can be done in any Factory raid.

name: Belka and Strelka

objectives.text: Survive and extract from Customs through Railroad Passage (Flare)

guide: In this quest you have to extract from Customs via the "Railroad Passage" extraction with the "survived" status. For the extraction to open, you have to shoot a green flare into the sky while being inside the signal flare area. Upon entering the signal flare area, a notifcation will pop up in the bottom right corner of the screen: If the flare doesn't reach a certain height, the extraction won't open. If the flare was fired correctly, a new notification pops up: You can use either the handheld RSP-30 green flare provided by Prapor via in-game mail or a 26x75mm green flare cartridge fired from a signal pistol. If you use the handheld RSP-30 green flare, make sure to aim it upwards, but not too much or it lands behind you. If you need additional flares you can buy them from Jaeger. To avoid the "run through" status, gain at least 200 EXP in raid (by killing or looting) or be in raid for at least 7 minutes before extracting.
notes: Belka and Strelka are names of the first two dogs who went to the Earth's orbit and returned alive.

items: Unlocks purchase of Aluminum splint at Therapist LL3

guide: In this quest you have to gain and maintain the effect for 8 minutes. The effect is caused by constant use of stamina during the critical amount state (red bar) and can be stacked infinitely. One stack only lasts for 3 minutes, so continual use of stamina in the the critical amount state is required to get the effect for 8 minutes. guide:
The required room is the "Breach Room" on Factory. Place 3x Gunpowder "Kite" while night time there.
The "Breach Room" is the room between the office and the locked room on the third floor. Each Gunpowder "Kite" takes 30 seconds to place, leading to a total placement time of 90 seconds. Closing the door to the breach room is recommended while placing them, as Scavs will wander down the hallway periodically. If you wish to complete this quest with little to no resistance it is recommended to bring a squad to defend you as you plant the items. You do not have to successfully extract to complete this quest.

name: Immunity (quest)

objectives.text: Extract from the location with the "Unknown toxin" status effect

guide:
In this quest you have to extract from a raid while suffering from the effect.

The effect is inflicted by being stabbed with a Cultist knife, by either a Cultist or another player. Barbed wire in The Labyrinth also has a chance to inflict the effect upon contact.

While being afflicted with the status effect, your health points will drain at a rate of 140/min. You can use a Propital injector to partially counteract the health drain for 5 minutes, or an ETG injector to fully nullify the damage for 60 seconds. It is highly recommended to bring multiple medkits.

notes:
*The "outside contact" that is hinted at in the dialogue and success message, is the character "Deadpool" from the Marvel Cinematic Universe.
*The "amphibian pizza lovers' hideout" is a reference to the "Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles" franchise.
*The "burned girl's sickroom" is a reference to Alessa Gillespie, one of the main characters in the "Silent Hill" game series.
*The "barbed wire body" is a reference to the game "Death Stranding".
*The "really scary hole in the wall" is a reference to the game "Silent Hill 4: The Room".
*The "high rise where one die-hard guy kicked ass" is a reference to the movie "Die Hard".
*The "computer with a joke for programmers" is not a reference to anything in particular, but shows a folder with the name "gun porn", an opened text document with binary code that decodes to "there is no escape from Tarkov" as well as an ongoing "Minesweeper" game.
*The "little chair surrounded by big black chairs" is a reference to the meme "Piper Perri Surrounded".
*"Your friend Wilson" is a reference to the movie "Cast Away".
*The "kindled rest place" is a reference to "Dark Souls" game series.
*The "ominous welcome sign" is a reference to the "Silent Hill" game series.
*The "megagenius scientist's seat" is a reference to the "Rick and Morty" sitcom series.
*The "place where conscripts did a very important task" is a reference to soldiers cleaning their barracks for visits of higher-ups, even "painting the grass green" to make a good impression.
*The "two chair riddle" is a reference to a Russian prison riddle/initiation ritual "There are two chairs. One has sharp knives sticking out. The other has erect penises. Which one do you sit on and which one do you have your mother sit on?"
*"Every tank driver's first videogame" is a reference to the game "Battle City".
*The "bucket-head villain" is a reference to the "Silent Hill" game series.
*The "Anvil 3-4 crew member's execution site" is a reference to the game "Battlefield 3".
*"Every indie developer's worst nightmare" is a reference to the game engine "Unity", which the game is made with. The developers have mentioned multiple times that the engine was not the best choice for the game.
*The "room where the firefighter burned the books to become happy" is a reference to the novel "Fahrenheit 451".
*The "place where some valve technicians couldn't finish their third project" is a reference to the unannounced game "Half-Life 3" from the developer Valve.
*The "dangerous Russian chocolate beauty" is a reference to the chocolate brand "Alenka" and the "The Terminator" movie series.
*The "conspiracy theorist's room" is a reference to the meme "Pepe Silvia".
*"Where someone thought he'd get transported to the magic school" is a reference to the "Harry Potter" movie series.
*The "mother of all strategy games" is a reference to the game "Minesweeper".
*The "stairway to the skies" is a reference to the song "Stairway To Heaven" from Led Zeppelin.
*The "bear who sat into a flaming car" is a reference to the Russian joke "Bear walks by the forest, sees a burning car. He sits inside and burns to ashes."
*According to the developers, the room with the "upside-down chair" was originally planned to get a spooky atmosphere, but the idea was never finished.
*The "not-so-lonely bathroom" is a reference to the meme "Versus Pooping".

====Quest description decryption====
Solving the riddle starts with the quest description, the first paragraph of the hex encoded text equating to At interchange we were at bash zyxwvutsrqponmlkjihgfedcba pryz1uts8q5onmlkj3hgfe4c2a and the second one to 6t th1 1na of 8t 6ll, 2ou must 58ll th1 58ll6 and UrAgCe DEroRRiM. The first uncovered paragraph indicates the existence of Atbash ciphered text, the text zyxwvutsrqponmlkjihgfedcba pryz1uts8q5onmlkj3hgfe4c2a equating to abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz kiba1fgh8j5lmnopq3stuv4x2z, a clear substitution pattern. Using the aforementioned substitution pattern, we can take the second paragraph found in the quest description and translate it to 6t the end of it 6ll, you must kill the kill6, a clue which will become useful later along with the UrAgCe and DEroRRiM texts. 

====Quest reward text decryption====
The first operation to be applied to the quest reward text seems obvious, either from the DEroRRiM (MiRRorED if mirrored) text or from the nature of the text, it being a simple mirror of the whole text block. After a mirror, the paragraph First truth is, at the base you see the sum of 4 and 6, second truth is that thirteen is false number is revealed, making us understand that the number 13 should be eliminated in all further findings and that the base being used for them will be 64, instead of the human-used 10. Thus, after removing the already used text, removing the number 13 and decoding the text from Base64, we can observe the following text: thirteen is rot ten number as well, rotate yourself out of it which indicates the use of the rot13 cipher. After another removal of our used text and a rot13 decryption we can observe the following lines: Affine brought you two of the first numbers coupled with vjg pwodgt qh uycp ykvjjqnfu hkxg and how many steps should emperor of rome walk, one or three coupled with bgufs efbmjoh xjui txbot, zpv xjmm gjoe zpvstfmg jo b trvbsf pg gpvs / wkhuh lv d vshfldo sodfh wr uhyhdo brxuvhoi lq d vkdsh ri wxeh, wkh vkruw zdb wx.eh which indicate the Affine and Caesar ciphers respectively. After decyphering the Affine encoded text with the values a = 1; b = 2 we obtain the number of swan withholds five and after decoding the Caesar encoded texts with a shift of 1 and 3 respectively we obtain after dealing with swans, you will find yourself in a square of four / there is a special place to reveal yourself in a shape of tube, the short way tu.be, both clues helping later. 

====Piecing everything together====
To continue, we'll start with the remainder of our quest reward text: 266b2269726c336c4261 a hex encoded string which we should not decrypt for now. The clue the number of swan withholds five shows that 2 (a number which looks similar to a swan) should be replaced by the number 5, doing so in our hex text and then finally decoding it, indicated by the square of four clue, giving us VkUiul3lEa. Looking closely at the obtained string, we can observe the existence of the word killa within it, the clue 6t the end of it 6ll, you must kill the kill6 telling us to remove it from the text. Doing so will finally reveal the text VUu3E which if attached to the UrAgCe string obtained earlier, and being added onto a YouTube short link, as indicated by there is a special place to reveal yourself in a shape of tube, the short way tu.be revealing a YouTube video.

====The pastebin====
Approximately a week after finding the first YouTube video, a Pastebin link surfaced in the video description. For ease in describing the decryption progress, we'll split the document in 4 sections, one for each paragraph and will start with the last one since it exposes the 1st step within the process.

=====Paragraph 4=====
The paragraph is Base64 encoded, but before decoding it, all characters that are found surrounded by a + character need to be deleted and the contents need to be set aside to form the string 524f543437 which equates to ROT47 in hexadecimal. After the removal of the odd characters, the text File119111====T10p2 ...Be advised, we've got... (transmission interrupted)====end of file is revealed. We can note down the "file number" as the rest is just flavor text.

=====Paragraph 3=====
Using the former ROT47 clue we can solve this paragraph, applying a ROT47 decryption after a Base64 decode yielding the content we need, but slightly malformed. To clear this malformation every 22nd character in the original string needs to be removed (all of the characters being a 0), thus revealing File108070107==== T10p1 Overseer, this is team 8 unit 13 Foreman callsign. We got ambushed, requesting backup.... ====end of file. Like the last paragraph, we can ignore all text besides the file number.

=====Paragraph 2=====
After a reverse of this paragraph we can observe the string m1560red})>/|:\ (originally t3bahpl4{()}der0651m) is an outlier and will serve as a clue later, so we can remove it. The rest of the paragraph (still reversed) can simply be Base64 decoded to find File086078121==== OVRp2 ...Possible locals ambush. ====end of file. As with the former paragraphs, keep the file number and ignore the rest.

=====Paragraph 1=====
As with the former paragraphs we start with a simple Base64 decode. We can now take the m1560red})>/|:\ clue and use it as a substitute alphabet while ignoring the importat numbers, giving us the File082056117==== OVRp1 team 10, recon detail, moving to polikhim 1-12. backup call from team 8, unknown detail.... ====end of file string, which again, can be disregarded besides the file number.

====Finale====
Concatenating all file numbers together yields 082056117086078121108070107119111. If we group the characters and get their coresponding ASCII character, we obtain R8uVNylFkwo which leads to the final YouTube video. The video had a few game keys in its description.

name: Chemical - Part 4

objectives.text: Locate the transport with the chemicals on Customs
Mark the vehicle with an MS2000 Marker

guide:
By completing either Out of Curiosity or Big Customer, you will fail and lose access to this quest.

If you do not have one already, purchase a MS2000 Marker from Prapor.
After placing the marker, the player must stay alive for 30 seconds or they will have to place another beacon in the van. You do not need to be near the van after the marker has been placed. Find a nearby hiding spot and wait until the timer is complete.
notes:
* You can buy additional MS2000 Markers from Prapor or Ragman if needed.
* It is recommended that the player keeps the MS2000 Markers in their special slots or pouch so they are not lost in the event of their death.
* The MS2000 Markers will automatically be used out of the players' inventory when needed, similar to how keys work

An Iron gate key is required to enter the cell.

In this quest you first have to find the debtor on Streets of Tarkov. He can be found in room 206 on the second floor of the northern Pinewood hotel building. The room does not require a key.

Next you have to find the prison warden's apartment. The apartment is located in the Chekannaya 15 apartment building on Streets of Tarkov. A Chekannaya 15 apartment key is required to enter the apartment. The wanted apartment is the easternmost one on the second floor. It can only be accessed via the western staircase from the third floor through a hole in the floor of cell #5. The debris in the second floor hallway can only be passed by proning.

name: Serious Allegations
requirementsText: This quest is only available to buyers of the "Edge of Darkness" edition of the game.

objectives.text: Locate and obtain the hard drive at the old house on Shoreline
Hand over the found item

guide:
In this quest you have to find a hard drive on Shoreline. This item has 13 spawn locations: 9 spawns across 5 houses in the north-western swamp village, 3 spawns in a house west of the cottages, and 1 spawn on a rock in the south-eastern part of the map.

▸ Swamp village houses

▸ House #1 - 2 spawns

▸ House #2 - 2 spawns

▸ House #3 - 2 spawns

▸ House #4 - 1 spawn

▸ House #5 - 2 spawns

▸ House #6 - 3 spawns

▸ South-eastern rock
notes: The quest dialogue is referencing an incident that happened in 2018 between the content creator Eroktic and Battlestate Games. Eroktic uploaded a YouTube video in which he talked about an alleged user data leak from 1,900,000 game accounts, without providing any actual evidence. In response, Battlestate Games issued 47 DMCA strikes on his YouTube channel to stop the spread of misinformation, which were later removed. Battlestate Games commented on the allegations in a Facebook post.

Hand over the found item

guide:
In this quest you have to find the Nuclear power unit control log on Icebreaker. It can be found either in the central control station room, in the overseeing cabin in the engine room, or in the automation room under the engine room.

▸ Central control station room - Level 0

▸ Overseeing cabin in the engine room - Level -2

▸ Automation room under the engine room - Level -3
This room requires a code to be entered. The code can be found in a nearby overseeing cabin on a pinboard. The code changes every raid.

name: Saving the Mole

objectives.text: Access the lab scientist's office on Ground Zero
details: (Optional) Locate the USEC group at the parking lot of the TerraGroup complex
(Optional) Locate the lab scientist in the TerraGroup complex

objectives.text: Locate and obtain the scientist's hard drive
Hand over the hard drive

guide:
In this quest you first have to locate the lab scientist in the main building of the TerraGroup building complex. He can be found in a hallway behind the big TerraGroup sign in the entrance hall, buried under rubble. Inside the body, a TerraGroup science office key can be found which unlocks office no. 4 on the second floor. A single key is guaranteed to spawn every raid, but can be taken by other players.

Afterwards you have to find a hard drive in the scientist's office (no. 4) on the second floor. The office can be unlocked with the TerraGroup science office key.

Once you are inside the office, the hard drive can be found at the only desk with turned on screens. It can be located on the desk top, or in the right side shelf.

name: Back Door

objectives.text: Locate the secret underground bunker exit on Reserve
details: (Optional) Locate the switch that activates the exit

objectives.text: Survive and extract from the location through the secret exit

guide:
This quest requires you to extract with the "D-2" extraction on Reserve.

First, turn on the power with a lever in the command part of the underground bunker system. Be aware, activating the lever has the chance to spawn Scav Raiders in the command part of the bunker. Then, press the button on the wall next to the sliding door at the extraction. You need to exit the raid with the "Survived" status to get the quest completion. The "Run Through" status will not complete the quest. To avoid the "Run Through" status, gain at least 200 EXP in raid (by killing or looting) or be in raid for at least 7 minutes before extracting.

name: The Survivalist Path - Zhivchik

objectives.text: Survive for 5 minutes while suffering from complete dehydration (Excluding Factory)
Survive and extract from the location

items: Unlocks barter for SOG Voodoo Hawk tactical tomahawk at Jaeger LL2

guide:
You can consume certain items that decrease your hydration to quickly get into the dehydration state. For example, a Jar of DevilDog mayo gives -99 and a Can of condensed milk -65 hydration. You can also use the gym module in your hideout to drain energy and hydration before starting a raid.

Alternatively, if you play with friends, you can ask them to shoot you in the stomach, which will get you into the dehydration state too. Keep in mind that this will also decrease your energy rapidly.

Don't forget to bring enough Meds or a Propital regenerative stimulant injector to outheal the damage, and enough Drinks to continue the raid afterwards.

If you extract from the raid with the "Run Through" extraction status, the quest will not count as being completed. To avoid the "Run Through" status, gain at least 200 EXP in raid (by killing or looting) or be in raid for at least 7 minutes before extracting. If you happen to get a run through, you can survive and extract from another raid on any location to complete the quest.
notes: Zhivchik (живчик) translates roughly to "lively" or "peppy".

name: The Survivalist Path - Wounded Beast

objectives.text: Eliminate 3 Scavs while suffering from pain effect

items: Unlocks purchase of Benelli M3 Super 90 12ga dual-mode shotgun at Jaeger LL2
Unlocks Bear Hideout shooting range target style

guide:
* Dehydration and broken bones cause pain. Easiest way to break your leg bones is to fall a few meters or to intentionally fail the Hideout gym training to break your arm.
** Using a Jar of DevilDog mayo is an easy way to achieve pain through dehydration, although it comes with the side effect of constant damage over time.
* Using painkillers, morphine and/or similar medication will remove the status effect, and as such kills will not count towards the quest.

name: The Survivalist Path - Tough Guy

objectives.text: Eliminate 3 Scavs in a single raid without using any medicine on Woods

items: Unlocks purchase of Surv12 field surgical kit at Jaeger LL3

guide:
*Do not use any Medical items while in a raid while the quest is active.
*If you complete the objective to kill the three Scavs without healing the task will still fail if you heal before handing it in. In addition, if you complete the objectives but do not click complete with Jaeger, then healing in a later Woods raid will cause failure of the quest.
*Surviving the raid is not necessary for the quest to be completed.
*Off-raid healing does affect this quest.
*Drinkable alcohol is a painkiller that will not fail this quest.

name: Cease Fire!

objectives.text: Survive and extract from Streets of Tarkov through Klimov Street

guide: In this quest you have to extract from Streets of Tarkov via the "Klimov Street" extraction with the "survived" status. For the extraction to open, you have to shoot a green flare into the sky while being inside the signal flare area. Upon entering the signal flare area, a notifcation will pop up in the bottom right corner of the screen: If the flare doesn't reach a certain height, the extraction won't open. If the flare was fired correctly, a new notification pops up: You can use either the handheld RSP-30 green flare provided by Jaeger via in-game mail or a 26x75mm green flare cartridge fired from a signal pistol. If you use the handheld RSP-30 green flare, make sure to aim it upwards, but not too much or it lands behind you. If you need additional flares you can buy them from Jaeger. To avoid the "run through" status, gain at least 200 EXP in raid (by killing or looting) or be in raid for at least 7 minutes before extracting.

guide:
▸ Locate the traces of the BEAR special squad
To fulfill this objective, you have to pick up and read the Bogatyrs patch from Customs, Woods, Reserve or Lighthouse.

▸ Customs
On a couch inside the cabin located on top of the hill southwest of the new gas station.

▸ Woods
On the ground next to the BRDM from the cargo convoy.

▸ Reserve
On a package on the upper roof of the airspace control center marked with white king.

▸ Lighthouse
On a sleeping bag in the BEAR camp.

▸ Learn more about the Bogatyr squad from the traders
Visit Jaeger in the menu through the trader screen and ask him about the BEAR patch.

▸ Locate the Ryabina outpost
The Ryabina outpost is located north of the sawmill on Woods.

▸ Find more information about the Bogatyr squad
To fulfill this objective, you have to pick up and read a note as well as pick up a quest item from the camp. Strelets' amulet should be transferred to the off-raid quest inventory to not lose it in subsequent raids. It will be needed later.

▸ Locate the Carousel outpost
The Carousel outpost is located opposite the IDEA store checkout area inside the ULTRA shopping mall on Interchange. From the outpost, you have to pick up two quest items, pick up and read 4 notes as well as pick up an audio tape. Taran's postcard and Voevoda's audio recorder should be transferred to the off-raid quest inventory to not lose them in subsequent raids. They will be needed later.

▸ Locate the Gnezdo outpost
The Gnezdo outpost is located east of the ULTRA shopping mall on Interchange.

▸ Search the Gnezdo outpost
To fulfill this objective, you have to pick up and read 5 notes as well as pick up an audio tape from the outpost.

▸ Locate the ambush spot
The ambush spot, specifically Moreman's grave is located near the ZB-016 extraction in the east of Woods.

▸ Obtain more information about the Bogatyr squad
To fulfill this objective, you have to pick up and read a note as well as pick up two quest items from the grave. Moreman's dogtag should be transferred to the off-raid quest inventory to not lose it in subsequent raids. It will be needed later.

▸ Retrieve more information about the ambush from Moreman's phone
Craft Moreman's audio tape #1 and Moreman's audio tape #2 at the Workbench level 1 in the Hideout and listen to them. Electricity is required during the entire process, otherwise it will be interrupted.

▸ Obtain Intelligence Center level 3
Upgrade the Intelligence Center to level 3 in the Hideout.

▸ Contact the Bogatyr squad
Contact Voevoda through the radio system at the Intelligence Center in the Hideout. First enter the frequency "35.70", as hinted at from the First piece of code note and Second piece of code note. Next enter the code "27.893.2000" as hinted at from Strelets' note.

▸ Gain access to Lightkeeper
Lightkeeper can be found on the Lighthouse location. He is located in a locked area on the 3rd floor of the lighthouse building at the peninsula territory.

The bridge that leads to the lighthouse is guarded by Zryachiy and full of Claymores. To safely pass the bridge and speak to Lightkeeper, an encoded Digital secure DSP radio transmitter is required. It deactivates the claymores and has Zryachiy not shoot you. The questline to obtain one starts with the quest To the Light - Trust but Verify.

Harming Zryachiy, one of his followers, or a Lightkeeper acquainted PMC in the lighthouse premises will decode your Digital secure DSP radio transmitter if you have it equipped (Attention: Unequipping it does not prevent this in local PvE game mode raids). PMC's that are acquainted with Lightkeeper can kill unacquainted intruders without penalty.

▸ Bring all the Bogatyr squad's items to Lightkeeper
Transfer Taran's postcard, Voevoda's audio recorder, Strelets' amulet, Moreman's dogtag and the Bogatyrs patch to the in-raid quest inventory and hand them over to Lightkeeper.

▸ Wait for Voevoda to reach out
Wait 6-12 hours for Voevoda to reach out, then contact him through the radio system at the Intelligence Center Hideout. Enter frequency "35.70" and the code "27.893.2000" again.

▸ Complete Voevoda's tasks
* Reach the Light Machine Guns skill level 5
* Reach the Assault Rifles skill level 10
* Reach the Stress Resistance skill level 10
* Reach the Strength skill level 15
* Eliminate any 15 targets without dying
* Eliminate 4 PMC operatives without dying

▸ Contact Voevoda
Contact Voevoda through the radio system at the Intelligence Center in the Hideout. Enter frequency "35.70" and the code "27.893.2000" again.

▸ Locate the traces of the traitors
The Note mentioning Prapor to pick up and read to fulfill this objective can be found at the BEAR camp on Lighthouse.

▸ Interrogate Prapor
Visit Prapor in the menu through the trader screen.

▸ Figure out how the cultists are connected to the General
*Not all spawn locations for the quest item require this key. It is not entirely needed to complete the objective.

To fulfill this objective, you have to pick up and read 2 notes from Shoreline and either Woods or Customs.

▸ Voevoda's photo with a cultist mark - Shoreline
In the house on the island.

▸ Note mentioning General
▸ Woods
At the marked circle in the woods west of the sawmill near the checkpoint.

▸ Customs
In the marked room on the third floor of the three-story dorms building. A Dorm room 314 marked key is required to enter it.

▸ Talk to Lightkeeper
Visit Lightkeeper on Lighthouse.

▸ Wait for Lightkeeper to prepare the documents on The Unheard
In a new raid, return to Lightkeeper's area on Lighthouse and pick up and read the Agent network deployment report. The objective will be completed after 6 hours.

▸ Rewards
* +144,000 EXP
* Voevoda's audio recorder
* Unlocks achievement This Is All (Not) Coincidence

This objective only happens if you have not completed Falling Skies.

Shoot a yellow flare into the sky while being at the Woods transit on Reserve. If the flare doesn't reach a certain height, the quest objective won't complete. You can use either the handheld RSP-30 yellow flare which can be bought at Prapor LL1 or a 26x75mm yellow flare cartridge which can be bought at Jaeger LL1, and is fired from a signal pistol. If you use the handheld RSP-30 yellow flare, make sure to aim it upwards, but not too much or it lands behind you.

Access Icebreaker through the Shoreline or Lighthouse transit.

▸ Check if any crew members survived on the ship
Talk to the scientist through the intercom located on level 1 of the Icebreaker on the east side of the ship.

▸ Access the engine room
Access the engine room by using the Boreas engine room keycard. Once the player reaches halfway through the engine room, Black Division operatives will come out of doors on the catwalks in front of the player.
▸ Locate and obtain the engine room keycard
The engine room keycard is located in the center medical room on level 1, next to an engineer body.

▸ Reach the engine room
Head to level 0 on the east side of the ship and find the locked door with a keycard reader right next to the control room.

Continue to navigate the ship, and take the stairs to level 1 to find the doors to the engine room. Unseal them then enter the room and go downstairs to level -2.

▸ Find a way into the icebreaker superstructure
The player needs to go to the extraction zone, but instead of extracting, go two levels down, turn around the helipad, and go all the way to the side of the ship, and go up to level 3 to find a door with a chain.

A group of Black Division operatives will be waiting for the player on the helipad, and another group under the helipad.

Once you reach the objective, try to open the damaged door locked with chains and you will be asked to find an explosive. You can now extract from the Icebreaker. At this point the quest Stick to It is unlocked.

guide:
▸ Learn more about The Unheard
See requirements.

▸ Learn more about TerraGroup's activities/Learn more about the "fuel" mentioned in the note
To fulfill these objectives, you have to pick up and read 2 notes from The Lab. The Document on changes in enterprise interactions can be found in the laboratory next to the dome on the first floor, and the Cargo transport fax can be found in office O23 on the second floor.

▸ Find more information about the special catalyst shipment
The Transport log with notes to pick up and read can be found on Factory.

▸ Locate Rzhevsky's service vehicle and obtain his personal belongings
The wanted car can be found near the LexOs car dealership on Streets of Tarkov. The Hard drive from Rzhevsky's car is located on the center console in the car.

▸ Retrieve the data from the hard drive in Rzhevsky's car/Read the transcript of Rzhevsky's conversation
Craft the Hard drive printout at the Intelligence Center level 1 in the Hideout and read it from the off-raid quest inventory. Electricity is required during the entire process, otherwise it will be interrupted.

▸ Locate and obtain the documents on the Blue Ice fuel catalyst research/Find as much information as possible about the plans of The Unheard
The Fuel catalyst test report and the Burnt document to pick up and read can be found in the TerraGroup storage room on Factory, which is located in the underground tunnels right next to the "Camera Bunker Door" Scav extraction. A TerraGroup storage room keycard is required to enter it. Both have multiple spawns throughout the room. 

▸ Search for any mention of A.P. in The Lab/Learn more about A.P.'s role and activities
To fulfill this objective, you have to locate 1 of 2 whiteboards and pick up and listen to 2 audio tapes located in The Lab.

▸ Locate A.P.'s room in the Health Resort/Obtain A.P.'s data storage device and his personal belongings
A.P.'s room is east wing room 305 at the health resort on Shoreline. The Sliderkey flash drive marked with A.P. is stuck into the laptop on the table. A.P.'s belongings in the form of TerraGroup corporate apartment key can be found on the right nightstand. The optional Fragment of an unknown document can be found on the left nightstand.

The optional Guard post note to locate the room can be found on the first floor of the health resort west wing, on the desk next to the security room at the southern entrance.

▸ Decrypt the flash drive from A.P.'s room
Craft the Decrypted Sliderkey flash drive marked with A.P. at the Intelligence Center level 1 in the Hideout. Electricity is required during the entire process, otherwise it will be interrupted.

▸ Ask Mechanic for help
Visit Mechanic in the menu through the trader screen and ask him about the flash drive. He will say that he cannot help, but that Elektronik can if you hand over 5,000,000 Roubles.

▸ Hand over 5,000,000 Roubles and the A.P. flash drive to Mechanic
Hand 5,000,000 Roubles and the Decrypted Sliderkey flash drive marked with A.P. over to Mechanic through the trader screen.

▸ Wait for the news from Elektronik
If you haven't had contact with Mr. Kerman before: Wait 6-12 hours then visit Mechanic in the menu through the trader screen.

If you had contact with Mr. Kerman before: Wait 1 and half a hour for Mr. Kerman to contact you and speak to him.

▸ Integrate the files from A.P.'s flash drive into a keycard and access the hidden room in his apartment
You first have to craft the Reprogrammed keycard for A.P.'s apartment lock (Green) at the Intelligence Center level 1 in the Hideout. The blue and red ones are false leads.

A.P.'s apartment is apartment 1 on the second floor of the Cardinal apartment complex on Streets of Tarkov. A TerraGroup corporate apartment key is required to enter it. Once inside the apartment, you have to go down the hallway to find the hidden room opened with the crafted keycard. In the room are 4 notes to pick up and read.

▸ Locate the cult victim's apartment
The wanted apartment is located on the third floor of the old apartment building behind the Klimov shopping mall on Streets of Tarkov. A Cult victim's apartment key is required to enter it.

To fulfill this objective, you have to pick up and read the Cultist priest's note from one of the marked rooms on Customs, Streets of Tarkov or Reserve. Note: The item doesn't spawn before the previous objective is completed.

▸ Customs
Marked room on the third floor of the three-story dorms building. A Dorm room 314 marked key is required to enter it.

▸ Streets of Tarkov
Marked room on the third floor of the northern abandoned factory building. A Abandoned factory marked key is required to enter it.

▸ RB-BK

▸ RB-PKPM

▸ RB-VO

▸ Locate the place marked with the Eye of the World on Lighthouse/Investigate the cultist room in the chalet/Obtain the victim's key
The wanted place is the small southern bedroom on the second floor of the northern blue chalet on Lighthouse. The Victim's note to pick up and read can be found on the adjacent balcony. 

The Station 14-4 KORD Arshavin K. pass (Damaged) is located on an ATV in front of the garage opposite the chalet.

▸ Locate the place marked with the Eye of the World on Woods
The wanted place is a house in the dilapidated village in the north of Woods. The Newspaper clipping from the cultists' house to pick up and read can be found on a whiteboard next to the desk.

▸ Locate the place marked with the Eye of the World on Shoreline/Investigate the area/Repair the Sordi tower
The wanted place is a red metal shack at the radio tower near the "Road to Customs" extraction on Shoreline. The Programmer's note to pick up and read can be found on a dead body next to the tower. To repair the tower, a Toolset has to be used inside the shack.

▸ Restore Arshavin's keycard

▸ Gain access to NGO Cobalt's secret facility
NGO Cobalt's secret facility is located in the basement of the power station on Interchange. A Station 14-4 KORD Arshavin K. pass (Restored) is required to enter it.

▸ Restore power at the station
To restore the power you have to swipe the Station 14-4 KORD Arshavin K. pass (Restored) at the keycard panel directly next to the entrance door.

▸ Turn on the cooling system in the server room
The server room is located behind the grate door. To turn on the cooling system, flip the lever in the back.

▸ Install a flash drive to download the data
The Secure Flash drive has to be stashed to the left of the cooling system lever in the server room.

▸ Investigate ARRS Station 14-4 KORD thoroughly
To fulfill this objective, you have to pick up and listen to the Mysterious audio tape from the safe next to the entrance door. The safe opens automatically after turning on the cooling system.

▸ Survive and extract from Interchange

▸ Find a way to disconnect the station from external agents
Return to the secret facility on Interchange and pick up and read the ARRS station mechanic's notes from the big desk.

▸ Restore the ARRS station to backup settings
Turn on the power again, then go inside the server room and press the button under the table.

Note: Only 1 player per raid can press the button and get progress on this objective. If you can't interact with it, return in a new raid.

▸ Collect the flash drive from the ARRS station
Pick up the Flash drive for ARRS station from the server next to the cooling system lever.

▸ Survive and extract from Interchange

▸ Hand over the flash drive with data to Mechanic
Hand the Flash drive for ARRS station over to Mechanic through the trader screen.

▸ Read the ARRS station specifications
Read the ARRS system specifications from the handbook.

* Unlocks achievement Through Another's Eyes
* Unlocks achievement When the Light Fades

▸ Skier - Woods
Kill any 3 targets on Woods and extract with either the "Survived" or "Run-Through" extraction status, or visit the location 3 times. The kills don't need to be performed in the same raid as the "survive" objective.

▸ Rewards
* Unlocks Peacekeeper as trader
* Unlocks Shoreline in the location selection

▸ Terminal
To complete the next few objectives you have to go to the south-east corner of Shoreline and interact with the intercom at the watchtower in front of the Terminal.

Be careful not to get too close to the Terminal wall, as there are guards that will shoot at anyone. Do not try to kill them, they return fire with deadly precision. Interacting with the intercom too many times after being told to leave will also lead to your death by the guards. 

▸ Prapor - Reserve
Extract from Shoreline with either the "Survived" or "Run-Through" extraction status, or visit the location 3 times. Afterwards visit Prapor in the menu through the trader screen and hand over 5 Dogtags when the dialogue option appears. The Dogtags can be obtained by taking them off dead PMCs (they do not have to be killed by your hand).

▸ Rewards
* Unlocks Reserve in the location selection

▸ Mechanic - Lighthouse
Visit Mechanic in the menu through the trader screen and hand over 8,000 Dollars when the dialogue option appears. Dollars can be purchased from Peacekeeper with Roubles.

▸ Rewards
* Unlocks Lighthouse in the location selection

▸ Factory to The Lab
In the sewer tunnel connected to the flooded area in the underground. TerraGroup Labs access keycard required. Transits are only available 1 min after raid start.

Next to the hangar on the first level.

guide:
In this quest you have to obtain the disk with unknown data through a unique sacrifice at the Cultist Circle in the Hideout.

The items that need to be sacrificed are: Programmer's diary (Copy), Expeditionary fuel tank (any durability) and Zibbo lighter.

Only these 3 items must be put into the Cultist Circle for the sacrifice to work.
notes: The first word in the phrase "Diary. wvyglv. oiphxifq: sbb onfz qulve. rgx: ssemddvyl" mentioned in the quest's description is hinting at where to get the key. The first letters of words in the table of contents in Programmer's diary (and likewise its copy) form together the word "UNHEARD". Using this as a key for the Vigenère cipher returns "circle. location: you know where. add: flammable", hinting at the sacrifice to obtain the Disk with unknown data.

name: Khorovod

objectives.text: Reach Interchange in the Khorovod mode

guide:
The Khorovod mode can be accessed in the top right corner of map-selection screen. A Khorovod armband must be equipped to enter a raid.

To complete this quest, you need to refuel the generators that power the Christmas trees on Shoreline, Lighthouse, Reserve, Woods and Customs with Special 40-degree fuel and afterwards transit to Interchange in one life.

When you refueled a generator, a 5 minute timer begins and you need to defend it against Scavs.

The generator may break down, requiring to be repaired. A Leatherman Multitool will speed up the repair, but it is not required. It's going to happen several times during the 5 minutes.

When the timer is over, use the transit to the next map and repeat till you reach Interchange. The generator on Interchange does not need to be refueled to complete the quest.

You will have to use transits in this order: Shoreline > Lighthouse > Reserve > Woods > Customs > Interchange.

▸ Tree locations

▸ Transit locations
▸ Shoreline to Lighthouse
In front of the Path to Lighthouse extraction.

▸ Lighthouse to Reserve
On the road leading to the Road to Military Base V-Ex extraction.

▸ Reserve to Woods
At the map border northwest of the train yard.

▸ Woods to Customs
Near the RUAF Gate extraction.

▸ Customs to Interchange
Next to the Trailer Park extraction, inside the bus.
